gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.
She showed great ___ (WISE) in avoiding the deal.
gaps.explanation: 'Wisdom' — the quality noun from wise (spelling: wise → wisdom).

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.
